content:
For the longest time, I thought I was reacting to the world. Turns out, I was just reacting to myself...


Somewhere along the way, I started realizing this perspective was always within me. Not because something dramatic happened, but because I finally slowed down enough to see how much of what I was seeing in people, in situations, in others was really just a reflection of where I was standing.


Same world. Different eyes.


Still figuring it out, but grateful for it.🦋
